name: hugo-music
description: Hugo Music — licensed music streaming (server, web, mobile, edge CDN, load balancer)

scripts.dev: npm run clean:ports && concurrently -n SERVER,WEB -c blue.bold,magenta.bold --kill-others "npm run dev --prefix apps/server" "npm start -w @hugo/web"
scripts.dev:mobile: npm run clean:ports && concurrently -n SERVER,MOBILE -c blue.bold,green.bold --kill-others "npm run dev --prefix apps/server" "npm start -w @hugo/mobile"
scripts.test: npm test --prefix apps/server && npm run types:check --prefix apps/server && npm test -w hugo-server && npm test -w hugo-api && npm test -w hugo-stream && npm test -w @hugo/client && npm test --prefix apps/edge && npm test -w hugo-balancer
scripts.gen: npm run types --prefix apps/server && npm run gen -w @hugo/client
